info.title: CosmosDBShell
info.description: Azure Cosmos DB Shell is a .NET tool with interactive navigation, query, scripting, and MCP server support for Azure Cosmos DB databases.

options.name: -c
options.description:
Executes the specified command and exits the
shell (for example: /c "help").

options.name: -k
options.description:
Executes the specified command and keeps the
shell running (for example: /k "help").

options.name: --connect
options.description:
The endpoint URL or connection string to connect
to.

options.name: --connect-tenant
options.description:
The Entra ID tenant ID to authenticate against
at startup.

options.name: --connect-hint
options.description:
Login hint for browser authentication at
startup.

options.name: --connect-authority-host
options.description:
The authority host URL at startup (default:
https://login.microsoftonline.com/).

options.name: --connect-managed-identity
options.description:
The client ID of a user-assigned managed
identity at startup.

options.name: --mcp
options.description:
Enable MCP HTTP server. Optionally specify a
port with --mcp <port>; default is 6128.

options.name: --lsp
options.description:
Enable Language Server Protocol (LSP) server for
editor integration

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Print full exception details instead of only the
message.
